description_expanded: OverviewHot TubSeagrove Beach- Public Beach - 3 Minute Bike Ride, Community Pool and Tennis, 3 Bikes Included `Luce Del Sol`The SpaceQUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Easy Keyless Check-in – Personalized lock code for stress-free access. 24/7 Concierge Service – Support whenever you need it! 2 Community Swimming Pools – Relax & cool off (no pool heat available). 2 Community Tennis/Pickleball Courts – Newly resurfaced for ultimate fun! 3 FREE Bikes – Explore Seagrove Beach & 30A in style! Nature Trails – Stroll scenic trails, feed the fish & turtles! Free Wi-Fi – Stay connected & stream your favorites. Flat Screen TVs – In the living room & all bedrooms for entertainment. 2 Parking Spaces – Convenient spots right behind the house. Beach Essentials – Umbrellas, chairs, & kids’ beach/pool toys included! Outdoor Shower – Rinse off sandy feet after a fun beach day!Welcome to Luce Del SolCome and see why staying at a home near 30-A will be the best vacation your family has ever had-and you'll know why people return year after year! No cramped hotel rooms, no waiting or driving to every meal or activity. Plan your 30A getaway at Luce Del Sol, a single-level 3 bedroom, 2 bath home located in the heart of Seagrove Beach. 10 minutes from all the great spots the 30A community has to offer. Perfectly situated in quiet Cassine Village. Relax or splash around at the 2 Cassine community swimming pools. Perfect that serve and backhand at the 2 private tennis courts, re-surfaced in 2020 and now with Pickle Ball!. Swimming pool and tennis/pickle ball are located just outside your back door.This home offers nearly 1500 sq ft of space to relax and spend time with up to 7 family members and friends.Master Bedroom has a king-size bed and attached en-suite full bathroom. Bedroom 2 has a queen size bed. Bedroom 3 has new twin bunk-beds with a pull out trundle to sleep 3.Gather out on the covered front porch or screened in back patio. Walk over to Goatfeather's Seafood to get some fresh fish and cook a great meal in the eat-in kitchen and gather around the table with ample seating for everyone.After, spend time in the comfortable and spacious living area, with a large comfy couch that seats 8, playing games or watching a movie with plenty of room to relax and spread out.Great dining options are just minutes away-Seaside, The Hub & Watercolor, as well as stores for other necessities like Publix, an Urgent Care Center & Tom Thumb convenience store.Rent bikes, golf carts, kayaks etc. from one of the local shops and get outside! There are multiple bike/walking trails around this pedestrian-friendly area. Explore the Cassine Garden nature trails, or go big and explore the Port Washington State Forest.Less than an hour's drive away from either Northwest Florida Beaches (ECP) or Destin Ft. Walton Beach (VPS) AirportsHouse Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS :Master Bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroomGuest Bedroom - Queen sized bed, shared bathroomBunk Room - Twin over twin bunk bed with trundle, shared bathroomAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
